title: SOLIPSCION
narrativeSpine: A child’s rain lesson becomes a multiworld inquiry into intervention, evaluative systems, and the lives classified by them.
firstSceneDraft: SOLIPSCION opens with a child learning to make rain by influencing another world.
She may nudge existing conditions, but cannot simply suspend its local laws.
Her chosen route uses fear to move a herd toward a hidden reservoir.
The tutor questions more than whether the intervention produces the intended result.
visualActionProposal: Six-legged herd breaks a salt crust above warm water beneath a folded pupil; later a feathered astronomer observes from basalt architecture, visually distinct from SOLIPSICON’s clinic.
